description: Convert an amount between currencies using current exchange rates based on the Philippine peso (PHP), e.g. 100 USD to PHP. Rates come from open.er-api.com and update daily.

from.description: 3-letter currency code to convert from, e.g. "USD"

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for structured data

to.description: 3-letter currency code to convert to (default PHP)

name: ph_convert_currency
title: Convert currency (Philippine peso rates)
